name: repo-card
title: Repo card
description: A code repository as a card: owner and name as one link, description, topics, language, stars, forks and when it last changed.
docs: name is the one link of the card (href, or onOpen for a button) and owner is written before it in a quieter weight; the whole card opens the repository, while the counts and the date stay separate targets above it. language is words beside a small neutral marker, never a brand colour. stars and forks are written short (12.4K) in the locale's own way and say the full number (12,384 stars) in a tooltip, which a tap opens too, and to screen readers. updatedAt is written in words (3 days ago) with the exact date in a tooltip; pass now to pin the clock for server HTML and tests, otherwise the card reads the browser clock after the first paint and writes the date until then. visibility is public or private, a badge with a glyph and the word. topics are tags, maxTopics (default 4) of them before +N, which screen readers hear as 3 more topics. labels carries every word, with {count} and {time} filled in.
